import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 1) if metric in ("share", "rank") else round(v, 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num_cols = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
                "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)

    # --- Totals ---
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", rev_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", rev_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", rev_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw and rev_lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if rev_ly and rev_ly != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if o_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - o_lw) / o_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # --- Top entities by revenue TW ---
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        sh = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", sh, "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) > 0:
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", 1, "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # --- Biggest absolute WoW movers ---
    m = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if not m.empty:
        m["abs_wow"] = m["Revenue_TW"] - m["Revenue_LW"]
        up = m.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(2)
        dn = m.sort_values("abs_wow").head(2)
        for _, r in up.iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        for _, r in dn.iterrows():
            if r["abs_wow"] < 0:
                add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # --- Biggest percentage WoW movers (meaningful base) ---
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    p = p[p["Revenue_LW"] > 0]
    if not p.empty:
        best = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        worst = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(best["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", best["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        add(worst["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", worst["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # --- Biggest YoY movers ---
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y = y[y["Revenue_LY"] > 0]
    if not y.empty:
        yb = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        yw = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(yb["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", yb["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        add(yw["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", yw["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        ya = y.copy()
        ya["abs_yoy"] = ya["Revenue_TW"] - ya["Revenue_LY"]
        ytop = ya.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ytop["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", ytop["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    # --- Units / orders leaders ---
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if not uu.empty:
        ru = uu.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ru["Entity"], "units", "TW", ru["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if not oo.empty:
        ro = oo.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(ro["Entity"], "orders", "TW", ro["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
